court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: III Additional District Judge, Trichy in CMA.No.6 of 2021
facts_of_case: The husband filed a petition for dissolution of marriage on the ground of cruelty and desertion. The wife sought interim maintenance and litigation expenses. The trial court ordered Rs.10,000/- as interim maintenance and Rs.10,000/- towards litigation expenses. Against this order, the husband preferred an appeal which was confirmed by the lower appellate Court.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking interim maintenance to establish a prima facie case.
legal_principles.held: Against which the present Civil Miscellaneous Appeal has been filed stating that the appellant is not in a position to pay the entire award maintenance within short span of time.

legal_principles.principle: A party's ability to pay interim maintenance is a relevant factor in determining the award.
legal_principles.held: The trial Court not apparent and the appellate Court not based on evidence on record and not properly appreciated passed the order.

outcome.final_order: The final court order set aside the order passed by the trial court and remitted the matter back to the trial court for fresh consideration.

use_for_drafting: using Hindu Marriage Act in family court
